data.name: Myriana
data.gender_notes: Myriana is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Myriana is a Greek female name derived from the word 'myriad' which means ten thousands. In the Bible, Myriana could represent the great multitude of believers who follow God. Alternatively, it could be the name of a Greek goddess, Myriana, who was a goddess of abundance and fertility. The name Myriana carries the meaning “Myriads, ten thousands” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek. Parents who choose Myriana usually hope their child will grow to embody myriads, ten thousands and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Myriana symbolizes the vastness and diversity of God's love and the great multitude of believers who follow Him.
data.etymology: Myriana belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Myriads, ten thousands.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Myriana total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: מיריאנה
in_hebrew.meaning: מיריאנה - שמן נשי המשלב מירי ואנה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מיריאנה הוא שם נשי שמקורו בשילוב של שני שמות עבריים: מירי, שפירושו 'מרגנית' או 'אהובה', ואנה, שפירושו 'חן' או 'רצון'. השם מיריאנה משלב את שני המשמעויות הללו, ויכול להתפרש כ'אהובה בחן' או 'מרגנית שרצון'. השם מופיע במסורת הנוצרית ומשמש כשם נשי בקרב קהילות יהודיות ונוצריות כאחד.

in_greek.name: Μυριανά
in_greek.meaning: Μυριανά - όνομα γυναικείο που προέρχεται από τις λέξεις μυρίος και άνα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μυριανά αποτελείται από δύο ελληνικές λέξεις: μυρίος, που σημαίνει 'αμέτρητος' ή 'πολύς', και άνα, που σημαίνει 'άνω' ή 'επάνω'. Η Μυριανά μπορεί να ερμηνευτεί ως 'πολύ υψηλή' ή 'αμέτρητη σε ύψος'. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Μυριανά συνδέεται με την πνευματική ανάπτυξη και την υψηλή θέση της ψυχής στον ουρανό.

in_latin.name: Myriana
in_latin.meaning: Myriana - nomen femininum ex vocibus myrios et ana compositum
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Myriana ex duabus vocibus Latinis derivatur: myrios, quod significat 'multus' vel 'immensus', et ana, quod significat 'surgo' vel 'ascendo'. Myriana ergo interpretari potest 'multa et alta' vel 'immensa in altitudine'. In traditione Christiana, nomen Myriana ad spiritualem crescentiam et ad sublimem animae statum in caelo refertur.

in_english.name: Myriana
in_english.meaning: Derived from Hebrew and Greek roots, meaning 'bitter' or 'wished-for child'
in_english.long_meaning: The name Myriana is a combination of two names, Myri and Ana. Myri is derived from the Hebrew word 'mar', meaning 'bitter', and Ana is from the Hebrew name 'Hannah', meaning 'gracious' or 'favored'. In Greek, the name relates to 'marys', meaning 'bitter', and 'ana', meaning 'gracious'. Myriana symbolizes a child born with spiritual significance, embodying both bitter experiences and gracious blessings. Historically, the name reflects a balance of trials and divine favor, cherished in Christian tradition.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Myriana: A beacon of infinite wisdom and grace, her name echoes the boundless love of the divine in every heartbeat. In the quiet corners of existence, she glows as a reminder of the infinite possibilities that the universe holds for us all.

historical_references.reference: Myriana, a 4th century Roman-Syrian saint, is believed to have been a wealthy widow who, following the example of the Biblical Susanna, gave away her possessions to the poor and was later martyred for her faith.
Myriana, a 7th century Irish saint, is credited with founding several monasteries and converting the pagan King Eogan mac Durgaidh to Christianity. She is also known as Myrnie, Myrrha or Merine.
